question: What RGB values are listed in Table 2A-2 for fluorescent yellow-green?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2A-2 does not list RGB values (or any numeric color coordinates) for fluorescent yellow-green or any other color. It is a matrix showing common uses of sign colors — i.e., which colors are used as legend and background colors for each type of sign — with fluorescent yellow-green shown as a background color for pedestrian, bicycle, and school-related signs. Per the MUTCD, actual color coordinates and values are specified in 23 CFR, Part 655, Subpart F, Appendix, not in Table 2A-2, and the exact coordinate values are not contained in the evidence provided. Standards (mandatory): - Fluorescent yellow-green has a defined meaning rather than a defined RGB value in the cited text: "Fluorescent Yellow-Green—pedestrian warning, bicycle warning, playground warning, school bus warning, and school warning." - "The standard colors of red, orange, yellow, purple, or the fluorescent versions thereof, fluorescent yellow-green, and fluorescent pink shall not be used as background colors for community wayfinding guide signs, in order to minimize possible confusion with critical, higher-priority regulatory and warning sign color meanings readily understood by road users." Options (permitted): - "A fluorescent yellow-green background color may be used instead of yellow for this sign" (unsignalized pedestrian crosswalk signs, R1-6 and R1-9 series). Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-2 ("Common Uses of Sign Colors"), which uses "X" marks — not RGB or coordinate values — to indicate that fluorescent yellow-green may serve as a background for Warning–Pedestrian, Warning–Bicycle, and School signs, and as a legend color for changeable message School/Pedestrian/Bicycle signs. [Image 2] shows the R1-6/R1-9 series signs with a note that a fluorescent yellow-green background may be used instead of yellow. [Image 4] shows non-vehicular warning signs (W11-2, W11-9, W15-1) noted with an asterisk indicating "A fluorescent yellow-green background color may be used for this sign or plaque."
